rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance annual cap
rules.requirement: Annual residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% or 80% of the CPI change over the most recent 12 months; if CPI is negative no increase is permitted. Owners may petition for relief to obtain a fair and reasonable return.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995 (cap does not apply to buildings constructed after that date); mobile home spaces offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.

exemption_tests.description: Mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990

rules.key_value: Lower of 3% or 80% of CPI change
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance (effective Nov. 19, 2021)
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.ambiguity_note: Headline says 3% cap; details say lower of 3% or 80% of CPI. Page is a news summary of the ordinance.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days, an owner may not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice. At-fault and no-fault causes are listed; owners must give notice and opportunity to cure before at-fault terminations, and for no-fault terminations provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the final 3 months of rent.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property other than exempt types, including housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels/transient, care facilities, dormitories and shared living quarters.
rules.exemptions_text: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.

exemption_tests.description: Housing produced in the last 15 years
Dormitories and other shared living quarters

rules.key_value: 3 months relocation assistance for no-fault terminations
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (effective Nov. 19, 2021)
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.ambiguity_note: The 15-year exemption is described as 'housing produced in the last 15 years' without specifying certificate of occupancy; the news page is a summary.
